title: 第2168章 炎鞭认主第2167章 炎鞭破封火柱冲天三方对峙最终战启
slug: 镇守仙秦地牢吞妖六十年
content_zh:
九尺长的鞭身在火焰中完全展开。
每一节都泛着金属般的赤红光泽。
鞭身并非平滑一体，而是由九十九节棱角分明的金属环扣衔接而成。
环扣之间隐隐有赤红色的流光游走。
此刻，每一节环扣上，都浮现出一道古老的铭文。
那是赤炎战祖在锻造时刻下的印记，在封印崩解、兵灵彻底苏醒的这一刻，重新焕发出光芒。
铭文的光芒与火焰交融，让整条炎鞭看起来不像是一件兵器，更像是一条从地心深处苏醒的赤龙，在火焰中舒展身躯，仰天长吟。
张远伸出手。
不是抓向炎鞭。
而是向着火焰中央，虚虚一握。
这个动作很轻，很缓，甚至没有带起半点风声。
但炎鞭的鞭身，却在那一刻微微震动了一下。
不是被火焰冲击的震颤。
而是一种仿佛从沉睡中被唤醒的、带着些许迷茫的悸动。
鞭身缓缓转动，赤红色的鞭梢在火焰中划出一道弧线，朝着张远的方向，偏转了一点点。
就那么一点点。
却让火山口内外的所有人，呼吸都为之一窒。
炎鞭的兵灵，在彻底苏醒的瞬间，便感知到了。
感知到了张远体内那股与其他封印之兵同源的力量。
镇岳的厚重、寒矛的柔韧、还有其他几道尚未完全显化却隐隐共鸣的气息。

那些气息交织在一起，在它的感知中，散发出一种跨越了漫长岁月、熟悉到令人颤栗的呼唤。
像是失散了无数年的同族，在无尽的黑暗与孤寂中，忽然听到了来自血脉深处的共鸣。
火焰依旧在冲天燃烧。
熔岩依旧在缓缓流淌。
但炎鞭的目光，已经穿过熊熊烈焰，落在了那个站在火山口边缘、衣袍飞扬的青年身上。
它，记住了这道气息。
赤红色的火柱冲天而起，将火山口映照得如同炼狱熔炉。
张远站在翻涌的热浪中，衣袍猎猎，目光却穿透熊熊烈焰，锁定了火柱中心那缓缓转动的九尺长鞭。
鞭身上赤红的铭文如呼吸般明灭，每一次闪烁，都让周围岩石熔融一分。
青铜短刀在数十丈外发出尖锐的嗡鸣，刀身上的星图腾纹路疯狂闪烁。
它感受到了威胁。
content_en:
The nine-foot-long whip body was fully unfolded in the flames.
Each section glows with a metallic red sheen.
The whip body is not a smooth body, but is made up of ninety-nine sharp-edged metal rings.
There is a faint red light flowing between the buckles.
At this moment, an ancient inscription appeared on every link.
That was the mark left by the Chiyan War Ancestor during the forging moment, and it glowed again at the moment when the seal collapsed and the soldier spirit completely awakened.
The light of the inscription blended with the flames, making the entire flame whip look less like a weapon and more like a red dragon awakening from the depths of the earth, stretching its body in the flames and looking up to the sky.
Zhang Yuan stretched out his hand.
It's not about grabbing the flaming whip.
Instead, he held his hand towards the center of the flame.
This movement was very light and slow, and it didn't even make the slightest sound.
But the body of the flaming whip shook slightly at that moment.
Not the tremor of being struck by fire.
Rather, it is a kind of throbbing that seems to be awakened from a deep sleep, with a slight confusion.
The whip body rotated slowly, and the crimson whip tip drew an arc in the flames, deflecting a little in the direction of Zhang Yuan.
Just a little bit.
But it suffocated everyone inside and outside the crater.
The soldier spirit of the Flame Whip sensed it the moment it completely woke up.
He sensed the power in Zhang Yuan's body that had the same origin as other sealed soldiers.
The thickness of Zhen Yue, the flexibility of Han Spear, and several other auras that have not yet fully manifested but resonate vaguely.
Those breaths are intertwined, and in its perception, it exudes a call that spans a long time and is so familiar that it makes people tremble.
Like a kinsman who had been separated for countless years, in the endless darkness and loneliness, he suddenly heard the resonance from the depths of his bloodline.
The flames are still burning in the sky.
The lava is still flowing slowly.
But Yanbian's gaze had passed through the blazing flames and landed on the young man standing on the edge of the crater, with his robes flying.
It remembers this breath.
Red pillars of fire rose into the sky, reflecting the crater like a purgatory furnace.
Zhang Yuan stood in the surging heat wave, wearing a hunting robe, but his eyes penetrated the blazing flames and locked onto the slowly rotating nine-foot long whip in the center of the fire pillar.
The red inscriptions on the whip flicker like breathing, and each flicker melts the surrounding rocks.
The bronze dagger made a sharp buzzing dozens of feet away, and the star totem pattern on the blade flashed crazily.
It feels threatened.
